categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Does not touch mempool policy, data structures, or fee estimation algorithms; only adjusts RPC presentation formatting.
categories.rationale: The PR only formats feerates in RPC responses and does not alter mempool acceptance, eviction, or estimation logic.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC method parameters and output formatting in src/rpc/.
categories.rationale: Adds an optional `sat_vb` parameter to multiple RPCs so callers can receive feerates in sat/vB instead of BTC/kvB. This resolves a known user friction point where external consumers must perform custom unit conversions, but remains a deferrable interface convenience.
